description: Work, banking, school enrolment, health coverage, a phone contract and a passport all key off CURP and the acta. One mismatch propagates into all of them.
energy_note: One wrong letter, in every system at once.

aspect: Late registration is common and costly to fix
description: Rural and indigenous births registered late or informally produce adults whose documents disagree with each other. Correcting a civil registry entry is a judicial or administrative process, not a form.
energy_note: Going to court to prove your own birthday.

aspect: Two surnames, and systems that hold one
description: Mexican naming uses paternal and maternal surnames. Foreign systems store one, truncate, or swap them - so the same man is several different people across databases.
energy_note: Filed under four versions of his own name.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the accent that is not there
description: His acta says Martínez. The bank's system dropped the accent and the second surname years ago. The clerk says the names do not match and he will need a document proving he is himself. He asks which document proves that. She does not know.
energy_note: Asked to prove he is the person standing there.
